text.description_html:
Laurey Paris Cabinet Pull in Oil Rubbed Bronze

The its unique, fancy design, the Oil Rubbed Bronze Paris Cabinet Pull will be a show-stopper on many kitchen cabinets. It has a deep, brown oil rubbed bronze finish well suited to old world decor. The 3 Inch Paris Oil Rubbed Bronze Pull comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey Paris Oil Rubbed Bronze Cabinet Pull:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • C/C Length: 3"
  • Overall Length: 3-3/4"
  • Projection: 1"
  • Package with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Paris Cabinet Hardware Collection.

Oil Rubbed Bronze Matte Black

Sold Individually
